figures.finding: A natural person comes of full age at eighteen and then has full exercise of civil rights; earlier marriage gives full capacity.
figures.applies: Lithuania, Civil Code art. 2.5 (the English translation as amended to 2011; the Seimas text refuses this client).

sources.said: On attaining full age, i.e. when a natural person is eighteen years of age, he, by his acts, shall have full exercise of all his civil rights and shall assume civil obligations.

figures.finding: Under fourteen, a minor's contracts are made by the parents or guardians; from fourteen to eighteen the minor contracts with their consent, but may alone dispose of his income and exercise copyright in his works; no share of earnings is set aside by the Code.

value.under14: parents or guardians contract for the minor
value.from14: minor contracts with parents' or guardians' consent
value.ownEarnings: from 14, may dispose of income alone
value.copyright: from 14, may exercise copyright in his works alone
value.reachesWritingDirecting: yes for a writer's copyright: a minor over fourteen exercises it alone

sources.said: Contracts on behalf and in the name of minor’s under fourteen years of age name shall be concluded by their parents or guardians.
Minors over fourteen and under eighteen years of age shall enter into contracts with the consent of parents or guardians.
shall have the right to dispose of their income and property acquired for that income, implement copyright to their works, inventions, industrial design

sources.title: Civil Code of the Republic of Lithuania, Law No. VIII-1864 (as amended to 12 April 2011), English translation on WIPO Lex
sources.said: On attaining full age, i.e. when a natural person is eighteen years of age, he, by his acts, shall have full exercise of all his civil rights and shall assume civil obligations. … Contracts on behalf and in the name of minor’s under fourteen years of age name shall be concluded by their parents or guardians. … Minors over fourteen and under eighteen years of age shall enter into contracts with the consent of parents or guardians. … shall have the right to dispose of their income and property acquired for that income, implement copyright to their works, inventions, industrial design
